newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials firm slightly.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials inched higher Thursday in brisk activity, according to market players.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures dipped 0.17 cent to settle at 55.87 cents a gallon.
USG prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded at 0.70 cent by late afternoon, a gain of about 0.10 cent from levels seen late Wednesday and early Thursday, traders said.
"There was pretty good action on both the buy side and the sell side today," one Gulf player said.
Prompt 55-grade low sulphur jet fuel on the Gulf was bid at 0.90 cents over the screen, up about 0.20 cent on the day.
